mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.category_id, c.name AS category_name, d.name, d.description, d.image_url, d.price, d.sort, d.status, d.create_time, d.update_time FROM dish d JOIN category c ON c.id = d.category_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT od.dish_id, SUM(od.quantity) AS sold FROM order_detail od JOIN orders o ON o.id = od.order_id WHERE o.status IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY od.dish_id ) sales ON sales.dish_id = d.id WHERE d.status = 1 ORDER BY COALESCE(sales.sold, 0) DESC, d.sort ASC, d.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
